_readme: Human review of the coffee dataset. Advisory record, not pipeline input - the extractor's own rules produce the same outcome, so nothing here is wired into data/overrides.json. Kept so a later reader can see which rows a person actually looked at.
notes: All 13 low-confidence / region-level pins were reviewed and kept; none dropped.
The 3 placed rows come from author_flair_text and are now produced by the extractor itself via flairPlace(), not by a manual force entry.

The 16 left-off rows were already excluded for having no resolvable location, so no override was added - adding one would move them into the 'manual override' bucket and misstate why they are off the map.
